display.purpose: Rare hero/stat numbers (dashboard totals, health figures).

body.purpose: Default reading size for list rows and general UI copy — the most common text style in the app.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels and column headers.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Centered blocking dialogs — the heaviest tier.

shadows.name: floating-card
shadows.purpose: Small hover popups and info cards.

shadows.name: tooltip
shadows.purpose: Lightest tier — informational only, never blocks interaction.

shadows.name: panel-edge
shadows.purpose: Directional shadow marking a docked side panel's edge.

shadows.name: modal-backdrop
shadows.purpose: Scrim behind a centered dialog, separate from the dialog's own shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrance motion for pop/dropdown/rise animations — fast-in, gentle settle.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: All entrance/hover/active motion — short since these fire on every menu and modal open.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Button/tab hover state, 150ms ease, opt-in per element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5b9cf6; color: #0b1220; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #4a4f72; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary / Trigger Button
components.description: Dropdown/menu trigger (e.g. Controls, Asset Filter), with an active-tint state when open or filtering.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #21233a; color: #a0a8c8; border: 1px solid #383c58; border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary--active { background: rgba(91,156,246,0.13); color: #5b9cf6; border-color: #5b9cf6; } .ds-badge { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(91,156,246,0.2); color: #5b9cf6; border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled field, error state on invalid.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #70788c; } .ds-input { background: #1c1e30; color: #cdd6f4; border: 1px solid #383c58; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 7px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5b9cf6; } .ds-input.ds-input--invalid { border-color: #dc2626; }

components.name: Card (list item)
components.description: Selectable list card (e.g. a route result), with a selected-state fill swap.
components.html:
Tokyo → Sydney
3 hops · 142ms · On-Net
components.css: .ds-card { background: #21233a; border: 1px solid #383c58; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card--selected { background: #272a42; border-color: #5b9cf6; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #cdd6f4; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 11px; color: #a0a8c8; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Modal Dialog
components.description: Centered confirm/edit dialog with backdrop scrim, Modal-tier shadow, and pop-in entrance.
components.html:
Discard changes?
This can't be undone.
components.css: .ds-modal-backdrop { position: relative; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); padding: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-modal { background: #21233a; border: 1px solid #383c58; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); padding: 24px 22px; width: 320px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-modal-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #cdd6f4; } .ds-modal-body { font-size: 11px; color: #a0a8c8; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-btn-ghost { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #383c58; color: #a0a8c8; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-modal-actions .ds-btn-primary { flex: 1; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Top-level mode tabs with a blue underline active indicator.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #21233a; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #70788c; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-tab--active { background: #1c1e30; color: #5b9cf6; border-bottom-color: #5b9cf6; }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Subtle, non-blocking label — opacity-only entrance, never a transform-based one (see Do's and Don'ts).
components.html: Dim assets that don't match your filters
components.css: .ds-tooltip { position: relative; display: inline-block; background: #161828; color: #cdd6f4; border: 1px solid #383c58; border-radius: 5px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); animation: ds-fade-in 0.15s ease both; } @keyframes ds-fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
RouteBuilder reads like a nautical chart table at night: a dark, precise instrument surface for reading real infrastructure, with the network itself — the map, the routes, the data — doing the talking. The default Dusk theme is the clearest expression of this: dark UI chrome floating over a lit street map, exactly like a lamp-lit chart table over paper laid on a real sea. Chart-Table Blue (the one accent) behaves the way an instrument light does — rare, purposeful, never decorative — and everything else stays quiet so it can stand out when it appears.

The UI is precise and quiet: bold labels (Inter at 700-weight is the default, not the exception) keep a dense information surface scannable, while a mostly-neutral, low-saturation palette and short, purposeful motion (120–180ms) keep that density from ever feeling loud. This is an Operate-mode tool — sales engineers and customers reading a real, buildable route through a real network — so scanability and trustworthiness outrank expression at every turn.
keyCharacteristics: Dark instrument-panel chrome over a legible map, in three interchangeable light levels (Dark / Dusk / Light) — Dusk is the canonical world.
One accent color, spent sparingly, on the one active/selected thing per view.
Bold (700-weight) labels by default; regular weight is reserved for read-only prose.
Shadow depth is a hierarchy signal, not a decoration — heavier shadow means "more above everything else."
Motion is short, purposeful, and fully respects prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Chart-Table Blue marks exactly one thing per view — the active tab, the current selection, the primary action. If two things are blue at once, one of them shouldn't be.

rules.name: The Bold-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Interactive and structural text defaults to 700-weight; regular (400) weight is reserved for read-only prose. A user should be able to tell what's interactive by weight alone, before reading it.

rules.name: The Depth-as-Priority Rule
rules.body: Shadow tier must track blocking priority: Modal > Popover > Dropdown > Floating card > Tooltip. A lighter-weight element should never cast a heavier shadow than something it can appear above.

dos: Do keep Chart-Table Blue rare — reserve it for the one active/selected thing per view.
Do default interactive and structural labels to 700-weight Inter; keep 400-weight for read-only prose only.
Do scale shadow depth to blocking priority (Modal > Popover > Dropdown > Floating card > Tooltip), never the reverse.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ("ease-out-expo") for entrance motion (pop/dropdown/rise) and keep durations short (120–180ms) — these fire on every menu and modal open.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: every custom animation and hover/active transition must collapse to instant/static under it.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color that competes with Chart-Table Blue for attention.
Don't rely on color alone to convey state — pair it with an icon, label, or border shift, since the palette must stay legible across all three theme modes (Dark / Dusk / Light).
Don't add a resting shadow to a flat, in-place surface (a card or panel at rest) — shadow is earned only by floating/layered elements.

Don't animate a CSS property that another animation on the same element already drives (e.g. transform) — a CSS animation owns its whole animated property for its full duration, so a second, independent use of that property (like manual positioning) gets silently overridden. Use an opacity-only entrance instead, or a different property, when an element also needs its own transform.
